alex_g: CI smoke for hosted-integ is red on shard 9 — started ~07:12 PT. Failing tests show intermittent 401s and streaming clients hanging after the token rotation deploy at 07:05. Failing test: integ/test_tool_streaming.py::TestStreamingTool::test_tool_call_schema. Logs: '401: invalid token' then 'recv timeout' from streaming runtime. CI build: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/12345. Can someone rerun shard 9 and kick off a bisect if it stays red?

ci-bot: flaky-detector flagged a sudden auth spike right after svc deploy at 07:05. Affected jobs: hosted-integ-smoke (shards 7-11). Annotated potential causes: token-refresh, LB drain. :rotating_light:

maya_k: I can rerun shard 9 now. Will do a clean rerun + a smoke run with older token pinned.

maya_k: /rerun --shard=9 — started. If this passes we likely have a rollout race. If it fails, please bisect commits 3f2a1..a1b9c. @samir can you peek at the proxy logs for hosted-api-03?

samir: on it. Early look shows a burst of 401s from hosted-api-03 around 07:06. Proxy logs show missing Authorization header on some keepalive requests — looks like a race during client token refresh + connection reuse.

julia_pm: FYI customer rollout scheduled 08:00 — if this is an infra regression we should gate the release. :warning:

alex_g: thanks. If rerun fails, let's capture tcpdump and increase auth logging on the next run (AUTH_LOG=debug). Also consider a quick workaround: disable connection reuse / keepalives for the test client.

maya_k: rerun finished — shard 9 still failing, same two tests, same errors. Minimal log snippet I pulled: ```HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: r12345
Authorization: <redacted>
Error: token expired``` Also noted streaming client stuck waiting on chunks after the 401. Filing bisect job now.

samir: starting bisect on commits 3f2a1..a1b9c. Quick experiment: disabling client keepalives made the smoke pass locally. I'll try that on a CI debug job and report back.

alex_g: great, keep us posted here. If bisect points to anything in the auth refresh path, we should revert the deploy until we have a fix.

(End of thread)
